summary.text: Ashley Herrmann is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 69, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Danny Alvarez.
Herrmann is a business owner who was the Democratic nominee for District 49 in 2024, losing to Jennifer Kincart Jonsson.

paragraphs.text: Ashley Herrmann, in a Ballotpedia survey, described herself as a first-generation college student and mother of two girls who was raised amid cow pastures and orange groves.
She said she has spent her career working for working families at the Florida Department of Transportation, in schools and in her neighborhood.
Ballotpedia's profile lists a Riverview High School diploma and a career as a business owner.
Herrmann ran in 2024 for Florida House District 49 and received 32.9 percent of the vote (26,217 votes) to Jennifer Kincart Jonsson's 67.1 percent (53,388 votes).

In her 2026 survey responses she named homeowner's insurance, transportation and climate as the most pressing problems in her community, and said she is passionate about cost of living, healthcare, public education and climate.
On insurance, she said she would seek legislation requiring insurers to respond to claims within 30 days and requiring legislative approval for rate increases.
